title: B2B SDR / Appointment Setter — Remote LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para B2B SDR / Appointment Setter — Remote LATAM em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

B2B Appointment Setter


Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month + $50 USD per qualified booked call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $3,250+/month, uncapped)


Apply Here to Stand Out: (


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


The Opportunity:


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter


Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses

Power BI Admin – Developer:


Advanced English


Role Summary:


The Power BI Admin/Developer is responsible for end-to-end Power BI platform management, development of BI solutions, and governance. This role combines technical development (reports, dashboards, data models) with administration (tenant setup, security, performance, and lifecycle management) to enable enterprise-scale analytics.


Key Responsibilities :


Power BI Development

· Design, develop, and deploy interactive dashboards and reports

· Build and maintain data models, datasets, and semantic layers

· Develop DAX calculations, measures, and KPIs

· Work with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions


2. Power BI Administration


· Manage Power BI tenant, workspaces, and environments

· Administer user access, roles, and security (RLS, permissions)

· Configure and maintain gateways, data refresh schedules, and connectivity

· Monitor usage, performance, and capacity (Premium/Embedded)

· Ensure data governance, compliance, and audit controls

· Manage deployment pipelines (Dev → Test → Prod)

· Troubleshoot platform issues and conduct root cause analysis

· Define and enforce Power BI governance framework (naming standards, workspace strategy, lifecycle policies)

· Manage versioning, CI/CD, and release processes

· Ensure data quality, lineage, and metadata management

· Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders

· Support audit, security, and compliance requirements


4. Stakeholder Collaboration

· Work with business teams for requirements and insights

· Provide support for users and resolve BI/report issues

· Conduct training, demos, and enablement sessions

· Provide executive dashboards and insights for leadership


Required Skills:


· Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (Desktop + Service + Admin Portal)

o DAX, Power Query (M)

o SQL and data warehousing concepts

· Experience with:

o Azure services / cloud data platforms

o Data governance, security, and compliance

o Performance optimization & capacity planning

title: Conteudista de tecnologia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Conteudista de tecnologia em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Rocketseat é um ecossistema de educação para Produtos Digitais, Programação e IA. Temos cursos do zero à especialização, Faculdade, MBA, Para Empresas e Para Escolas. A plataforma completa para estudar e criar projetos práticos que preparam para o mercado de trabalho.


Objetivo da função

Criar, desenvolver e revisar conteúdos educacionais digitais de alta qualidade para cursos, formações, treinamentos e demais produtos educacionais, garantindo alinhamento técnico, pedagógico e institucional.


Principais atribuições

  • Desenvolver conteúdos educacionais digitais conforme escopo definido para cada projeto.
  • Produzir materiais originais e tecnicamente corretos.
  • Elaborar videoaulas, apostilas, slides, exercícios, avaliações, desafios, estudos de caso e materiais complementares.
  • Estruturar trilhas de aprendizagem, módulos, disciplinas e jornadas educacionais.
  • Desenvolver exemplos práticos, projetos e atividades aplicadas.
  • Revisar e atualizar conteúdos para garantir qualidade técnica e pedagógica.
  • Realizar ajustes, correções e reestruturações solicitadas pelas equipes acadêmicas, pedagógicas ou de produção.
  • Garantir que os conteúdos estejam alinhados às diretrizes pedagógicas, identidade institucional e padrões de qualidade definidos.
  • Entregar materiais nos formatos, prazos e canais estabelecidos pela organização.
  • Colaborar com equipes de educação, audiovisual, produto e operações durante o processo de produção e validação dos conteúdos.


Perfil esperado

  • Pessoa da área de tecnologia com conhecimento em IA Generativa, No/Low Code e ferramentas automação digital como N8N e Make.
  • Capacidade de transformar conhecimento técnico em experiências de aprendizagem claras e aplicáveis.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização de materiais educacionais.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de ensino, aprendizagem digital e educação online.
  • Compromisso com qualidade, prazos e melhoria contínua.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Technical Support Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Customer Support Analyst (Technical Support)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join a global technology team supporting innovative digital products and platforms.

This is a long-term remote opportunity for professionals based in Brazil who enjoy solving problems, helping customers, and working closely with product and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with technical curiosity and the ability to troubleshoot software-related issues.

  • Maintain clear and professional communication with customers throughout the resolution process.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to escalate and resolve complex issues.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of support processes and knowledge base documentation.
  • Assist in monitoring service levels and support performance metrics.

Required Qualifications

  • 1+ year of experience in Customer Support, Customer Service, Technical Support, Help Desk, Service Desk, or similar roles.
  • Experience working with ticketing systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and customer-friendly manner.
  • Experience supporting a high volume of customer inquiries.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Professional English communication skills (written and verbal).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS products or technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Intercom, or similar support tools.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineering or product teams.
  • Previous experience creating support documentation or knowledge base articles.
  • Leadership or customer service management experience is a plus.


What We're Looking For

  • Customer-first mindset.
  • Empathy and strong communication skills.
  • Curiosity and passion for technology.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Continuous learning mentality.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.


Work Environment

  • 100% Remote (Brazil)
  • Long-term project | PJ
  • International team environment
  • Schedule aligned with U.S. Central Time (CST)

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Creative Director em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Director

Talent Global LLC — Remote

Full-Time (40 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity
  • Provide clear, actionable creative direction to designers and video editors based on client briefs and performance goals
  • Develop creative strategies for new content batches — defining concept, visual direction, messaging angle, and format
  • Identify creative weaknesses across active accounts and propose improvements proactively
  • Maintain a high creative bar across all output, with strong attention to detail in both visual execution and storytelling


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team
  • Strong portfolio spanning both video and graphic content — social ads, brand content, or performance creative
  • Ability to both review/direct existing work and develop new creative strategies from scratch
  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Salary - 120,898 BRL Annually

Fully Remote

Start Date - ASAP, need immediate joiners


Must Haves:

Enterprise PM experience: 2–4+ years managing large, high-risk IT projects (data, infrastructure, or application development) in global environments

Strong, assertive PM leadership: Proactive “activist” PM who can drive projects forward, make tough decisions, and push back when needed

Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe preferred), with flexibility to work across Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid environments

Full lifecycle ownership: Ability to manage scope, timelines, budgets, and cross-functional teams across multiple concurrent projects (often 3–4 at a time)

Strong communication & stakeholder management: Confident interacting across all levels, building relationships, driving accountability, and facilitating Agile ceremonies

Bilingual (English, Spanish, Portugues)

Financial background

Nice to Haves:

Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe Scrum Master, CSM/PSM, or other Agile certifications

Tools & platforms: Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, PowerBI, and collaboration tools like Miro/whiteboarding tools

Technical breadth: Exposure to both cloud and on-prem IT initiatives

Change management experience: Background in organizational change, adoption strategies, or transformation initiatives

Day to Day:

A client of Insight Global is seeking a Project Manager to join their team remotely. This individual will manage 3–4 concurrent enterprise IT projects across data, infrastructure, and application development. Day-to-day, they will drive delivery across Agile/Scrum, SAFe, and hybrid teams, lead standups and stakeholder updates, track budgets and timelines, and ensure scope alignment. They will proactively mitigate risks, enforce accountability, and communicate effectively across global teams in English and Spanish/Portuguese.

title: Data Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineer (Relocation to Portugal) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:


Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation. Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Data Engineer;
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and data integration solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering concepts.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms, databases, and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  • Availability and willingness to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team-building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

Advanced English

The Power BI Admin/Developer is responsible for end-to-end Power BI platform management, development of BI solutions, and governance. This role combines technical development (reports, dashboards, data models) with administration (tenant setup, security, performance, and lifecycle management) to enable enterprise-scale analytics.

· Ensure data quality, lineage, and metadata management

· Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders

· Support audit, security, and compliance requirements


4. Stakeholder Collaboration

· Work with business teams for requirements and insights

· Provide support for users and resolve BI/report issues

· Conduct training, demos, and enablement sessions

· Provide executive dashboards and insights for leadership


Required Skills:


· Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (Desktop + Service + Admin Portal)


· Expertise in:

o DAX, Power Query (M)

o Data modeling (star schema, semantic models)

o SQL and data warehousing concepts

· Experience with:

o Azure services / cloud data platforms

o Gateways, REST APIs, and integrations

· Understanding of:

o Data governance, security, and compliance

o Performance optimization & capacity planning

description:

Power BI Admin – Developer:


Advanced English


Role Summary:


The Power BI Admin/Developer is responsible for end-to-end Power BI platform management, development of BI solutions, and governance. This role combines technical development (reports, dashboards, data models) with administration (tenant setup, security, performance, and lifecycle management) to enable enterprise-scale analytics.

Power BI Development

· Design, develop, and deploy interactive dashboards and reports

· Build and maintain data models, datasets, and semantic layers

· Optimize report performance and usability

· Work with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions

· Manage Power BI tenant, workspaces, and environments

· Administer user access, roles, and security (RLS, permissions)

· Configure and maintain gateways, data refresh schedules, and connectivity

· Monitor usage, performance, and capacity (Premium/Embedded)

· Ensure data governance, compliance, and audit controls

· Manage deployment pipelines (Dev → Test → Prod)

· Troubleshoot platform issues and conduct root cause analysis

· Define and enforce Power BI governance framework (naming standards, workspace strategy, lifecycle policies)

· Manage versioning, CI/CD, and release processes

· Ensure data quality, lineage, and metadata management

· Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders

· Support audit, security, and compliance requirements

· Work with business teams for requirements and insights

· Provide support for users and resolve BI/report issues

· Conduct training, demos, and enablement sessions

· Provide executive dashboards and insights for leadership


Required Skills:


· Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (Desktop + Service + Admin Portal)


· Expertise in:

o DAX, Power Query (M)

o Data modeling (star schema, semantic models)

o SQL and data warehousing concepts

· Experience with:

o Azure services / cloud data platforms

o Gateways, REST APIs, and integrations

· Understanding of:

o Data governance, security, and compliance

o Performance optimization & capacity planning

title: B2B SDR / Appointment Setter — Remote LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para B2B SDR / Appointment Setter — Remote LATAM em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

B2B Appointment Setter


Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month + $50 USD per qualified booked call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $3,250+/month, uncapped)


Apply Here to Stand Out: (


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


The Opportunity:


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter


Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role

You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped

The Package: What's In It for You

Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per qualified booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Junior Technical Support Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Technical Support Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Customer Support Analyst (Technical Support)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join a global technology team supporting innovative digital products and platforms.

This is a long-term remote opportunity for professionals based in Brazil who enjoy solving problems, helping customers, and working closely with product and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and customer-friendly manner.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Professional English communication skills (written and verbal).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS products or technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Intercom, or similar support tools.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineering or product teams.
  • Previous experience creating support documentation or knowledge base articles.
  • Leadership or customer service management experience is a plus.


What We're Looking For

  • Customer-first mindset.
  • Empathy and strong communication skills.
  • Curiosity and passion for technology.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.


Work Environment

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Salary - 120,898 BRL Annually

Fully Remote

Start Date - ASAP, need immediate joiners


Must Haves:

Enterprise PM experience: 2–4+ years managing large, high-risk IT projects (data, infrastructure, or application development) in global environments

Strong, assertive PM leadership: Proactive “activist” PM who can drive projects forward, make tough decisions, and push back when needed

Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe preferred), with flexibility to work across Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid environments

A client of Insight Global is seeking a Project Manager to join their team remotely. This individual will manage 3–4 concurrent enterprise IT projects across data, infrastructure, and application development. They will proactively mitigate risks, enforce accountability, and communicate effectively across global teams in English and Spanish/Portuguese.
